page.layout: One column of running text, with the running head at the top and the page number at the top right. No marginal notes. The catchword "Deum" sits at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: quem necesse est praecedat adimpletio earum rerum quas per os Sanctorum suorum Prophetarum & Apostolorum futuras praedixit: quemadmodum enim superiori-bus seculis, majorum nostrorum saluti consulens, suscitavit quosdam qui eos velut oves errantes ad Christi ovile congregarent, ita hodie à nobis, illorum posteri (quod saepe repetendum erit) fructus debi-tæ gratitudinis requirens, Indorum dissipari tenebras, & in remotissimis orbis incogniti angulis lumen Evangelij collocari desiderat, idque quamprimum fieri flagitat; jam enim tempus est (postquam vocati ad nuptias Agni, quos ementita Bestiæ seduxit pietas, praeconum vocem contemnunt) ut à servis in vias & sepes prodeuntibus, cogantur cæci, surdi, & claudi accedere ad ta-bernaculum Domini; ne seducti Pseudo-Apostolorum vafricie (qui Dei quidem Israelis recordantur, sed non in veritate neque in justitia) gravem ac perniciosam An-tichristi servitutem, pro leni atque salutifero Christi jugo suscipiant; discantque illorum studio, antè Papæ adorare ima-gines, quàm (quod nostræ imputan-dum effet negligentiæ) per fidem ex E-vangelio conceptam, ad imaginem Chri-sti in novum hominem, qui secundum

page.notes: The catchword "Deum" is printed at the foot, right. Some long s and f forms were read as s throughout. The ligature and abbreviation for "idque" (idq;) and "&" were expanded only in the sense of keeping the printed form, as the printer set them. Some words at line ends carry printed hyphens and are kept as such. No doubtful readings in the body text.
